_comment: Padborn - gamepad suite: first-person block + sprint rescue + OStim controller layer + glyph bar.
Everything is optional and config-driven; delete this file for built-in defaults.
camera: blockFirstPerson true (default) keeps the player camera out of first
person no matter who asks - Game.ForceFirstPerson from any script, the vanilla
Toggle POV control, a save restore. Every blocked attempt is logged.
allowManualToggle true lets the keyboard POV key still switch (only forced
switches are blocked then); false (default) makes that key do nothing.
allowZoomIn true (default) still lets YOUR zoom-in (mouse wheel up, or the
Zoom In control) take the camera into first person, and it stays there until
you zoom back out. Scripts, the POV button and save restores stay blocked.
sprint: EXPERIMENTAL hold-to-sprint rescue, OFF by default. Only enable it if
your sprint presses get eaten (seen with Classic Sprinting Redone + TK Dodge
RE Addon together). log true writes per-press diagnostic lines to Padborn.log.
button: keep (default) leaves your layout alone; b / lb / ls moves the gamepad
Sprint control there at game load by swapping with whatever event held that
button - no controlmap file is touched, no CCS reinstall, flip any time.
OStim layer (ignored automatically when OStim.esp is not in the load order):
Bindings are keyed by SKSE gamepad keycode:
266 D-pad Up   267 D-pad Down  268 D-pad Left  269 D-pad Right
270 Start      271 Back        272 L3          273 R3
Actions: up, down, left, right, toggle, yes, end, speedUp, speedDown,
pullOut, autoMode, freeCam, search, alignment, hideUI
A binding may be a plain action name (fires on button-down, zero latency) or
an object with 'press' and/or 'hold'. A button carrying a hold action resolves
its press on release, so keep the constantly-used actions press-only.
hint: a slim glyph bar drawn near the bottom of the screen for the whole scene.
enabled false turns it off. scale multiplies its size. anchorX/anchorY place its
right/bottom edge as fractions of the screen. glyphs: auto (match the connected
pad), xbox, or ps. The Back button (hide UI) hides the bar too.
